name: Minimum CVaR Portfolio (full, alpha 0.99)
description: Minimum Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) optimization via Rockafellar-Uryasev LP: minimizes expected loss beyond the alpha-th percentile confidence level. Provides tail-risk management using scenario-based linear programming. Long-only portfolio with weights summing to 1. Full universe variant. Variant: {'alpha': 0.99}.
